description: This file provides support for integrating with CometAPI's chat completion endpoint, including configuration, request transformation, URL handling, exception management, and streaming response parsing specialized for CometAPI's API.

classes.name: CometAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class tailored for CometAPI, inheriting from OpenAIGPTConfig to handle API-specific parameter mapping, request transformation, URL generation, and error handling.

classes.name: CometAPIChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming responses from CometAPI, parsing individual chunks and managing errors.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to CometAPI format, with provision for adding CometAPI-specific parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[List[AllMessageValues],Optional[List["ChatCompletionToolParam"]]] remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], tools: Optional[List["ChatCompletionToolParam"]] = None, )
methods.description: Removes cache control flags from messages and tools if not supported by CometAPI.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms request data before sending, integrating optional additional body parameters.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for CometAPI, ensuring correct endpoint formatting.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns a CometAPI-specific exception class for handling errors.

methods.name: Any get_model_response_iterator( self, streaming_response: Union[Iterator[str], AsyncIterator[str], ModelResponse], sync_stream: bool, json_mode: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Provides an iterator for streaming responses from CometAPI.

methods.description: Parses individual streaming response chunks, handling errors and extracting message data.
